purpose: Machine-readable vocabulary for QUALITY-GATE.md. A review record is admissible only when it uses these exact tokens; acceptance still requires a lead-or-owner visual PASS on every applicable row.

verdict_normalization.purpose: The Stage-2/3 quality ledger records verdicts as prose with qualifiers (portrait-stage23-quality-ledger.v1). Normalize them instead of refusing them, conservatively: only a bare PASS counts as a pass.
rule: A token starting with PASS and carrying any further words is a QUALIFIED pass and normalizes to NOT_VERIFIED; a qualified pass is not a pass of the whole row.
A token starting with FAIL normalizes to FAIL, deferral included: deferring a failure does not clear it.
Every other token (NOT VERIFIED, NOT CLAIMED, BLOCKED, PENDING..., IMPROVED_NOT_ACCEPTED, NOT ACCEPTED..., APPROVED) normalizes to NOT_VERIFIED, because none of them is a recorded Q-row pass.
